pairs.target: yǎnliàn nàtiān , nányuàn ménkǒu guà qǐ le yìpái mùpái , měikuài pái shàng xiě zhe yìzǔ rén de míngzì .
pairs.english: On the day of the exercise, a row of wooden plaques hung by the south yard gate, each bearing a team's names.
pairs.hanzi: 演练那天，南院门口挂起了一排木牌，每块牌上写着一组人的名字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi láidezǎo , xiān kànjiàn le dé mǎ hé luò héng nà yíkuài , míngzì xiàmiàn tiān zhe yígè huà wāi de xiǎoniǎo tóu .
pairs.english: Tavi arrived early and first saw Dema and Lohen's plaque, with a lopsided bird's head added below their names.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维来得早，先看见了德玛和洛衡那一块，名字下面添着一个画歪的小鸟头。

pairs.target: dé mǎ shuō nà shì yàn . luò héng shuō tā méi huà .
pairs.english: Dema said it was a goose. Lohen said he hadn't drawn it.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛说那是雁。洛衡说他没画。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ móxíng fàngzài gōngyòng cháng zhuōshàng , wéilán quēkǒu cháowài .
pairs.english: Mira put the model on the communal long table, the gap in its fence facing out.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把模型放在公用长桌上，围栏缺口朝外。

pairs.target: děng yīwén cóng lǐng tú de duìwu lǐ chūlái , tāmen cái kànqīng jīnrì yào sòng de dōngxī :
pairs.english: Only when Iven emerged from the queue for maps did they get a clear view of what they had to deliver today:
pairs.hanzi: 等伊文从领图的队伍里出来，他们才看清今日要送的东西：

pairs.target: yìzhī mùxiá , lǐmiàn fàng zhe sānméi sōng tào zài zhù shàng de cí huán .
pairs.english: a wooden box containing three ceramic rings loosely fitted over posts.
pairs.hanzi: 一只木匣，里面放着三枚松套在柱上的瓷环。

pairs.target: xiázǐ qīng dé tài lìhài , huán biàn huì pèng xiǎng .
pairs.english: If the box tilted too far, the rings would clink together.
pairs.hanzi: 匣子倾得太厉害，环便会碰响。

pairs.target: kěyǐ liǎnggè rén tái , yě kěyǐ huànshǒu , dàn bùnéng chāikāi , bùnéng bǎng sǐ , gèng bùnéng shǐyòng jiè xìng .
pairs.english: Two people could carry it, or switch hands, but they couldn't dismantle it or bind anything fast, much less use borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 可以两个人抬，也可以换手，但不能拆开、不能绑死，更不能使用借性。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī zhàn zài táijiē shàng shuō guījǔ , sǎngzi chēng búdào yuàn wěi , ài kē biàn tì tā chóngfù .
pairs.english: Teacher Jian stood on the steps explaining the rules, but his voice couldn't carry to the far end of the yard, so Eko repeated them for him.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师站在台阶上说规矩，嗓子撑不到院尾，艾珂便替他重复。

alignment.english: the far end of the yard

pairs.target: jīnrì kāifàng de zhǐshì nányuàn jǐchù tíngyòng de liànxí wū , xiànlù hé dìmiàn dōu yǐ jiǎnchá .
pairs.english: Only several disused practice rooms in the south yard were open today; their circuits and floors had all been inspected.
pairs.hanzi: 今日开放的只是南院几处停用的练习屋，线路和地面都已检查。

pairs.target: hóng shéng wéizhù de dìfāng búsuàn lù , bùxǔ kuà .
pairs.english: Areas cordoned off with red rope weren't routes and mustn't be crossed.
pairs.hanzi: 红绳围住的地方不算路，不许跨。

pairs.target: měizǔ yào àn shùnxù zhǎodào liǎngchù jìhào , zài bǎ xiázǐ sòngdào zhōngdiǎn .
pairs.english: Each team had to find two markers in order, then deliver the box to the finish.
pairs.hanzi: 每组要按顺序找到两处记号，再把匣子送到终点。

pairs.target: lòudiào yíchù , zǒu dé zài kuài yě méiyǒu yòng .
pairs.english: Miss one, and speed would do them no good.
pairs.hanzi: 漏掉一处，走得再快也没有用。

pairs.target: dìyīshēng luó xiǎng , dé mǎ hé luò héng biàn táiqǐ mùxiá .
pairs.english: At the first gong, Dema and Lohen lifted their box.
pairs.hanzi: 第一声锣响，德玛和洛衡便抬起木匣。

pairs.target: liǎng rén méiyǒu pǎo , zài dìyīdào ménkǒu tóngshí cèshēn , xiàng zǎo bǎ duìfāng de jiānkuān yě suànjìnqù le .
pairs.english: They didn't run; at the first doorway they turned sideways together, as though they had calculated each other's shoulder widths beforehand.
pairs.hanzi: 两人没有跑，在第一道门口同时侧身，像早把对方的肩宽也算进去了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn dé xīnlǐ yì jǐn .
pairs.english: Tavi watched with a tightening in his chest.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看得心里一紧。

pairs.target: lún dào tāmen chūfā shí , tā zhǔdòng zhàn dào hòu duān , ràng yīwén ná tú , mǐlā lǐng qiántou .
pairs.english: When their turn came, he volunteered for the rear end, leaving the map to Iven and the front to Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到他们出发时，他主动站到后端，让伊文拿图、米拉领前头。

pairs.target: xiázǐ dǐxià de mùtiáo lüè zhǎi , tā xiān shì le wòfǎ ,
pairs.english: The wooden strip beneath the box was rather narrow; he tried his grip first,
pairs.hanzi: 匣子底下的木条略窄，他先试了握法，

pairs.target: zhǐjié méiyǒu gè zhù , cái shuō kěyǐ zǒu .
pairs.english: and only when his knuckles weren't digging against it did he say they could go.
pairs.hanzi: 指节没有硌住，才说可以走。

pairs.target: dìyīchù jìhào zài èrcéng píngtái xià .
pairs.english: The first marker was beneath a second-floor landing.
pairs.hanzi: 第一处记号在二层平台下。

pairs.target: tú shàng hěn róngyì bǎ shànglóu de xiàn kànchéng tōngdào , tǎ wéi zhèhuí xiān kàn le biāogāo .
pairs.english: On the map it was easy to mistake the stair line for a passage; this time Tavi checked the elevation first.
pairs.hanzi: 图上很容易把上楼的线看成通道，塔维这回先看了标高。

pairs.target: tāmen cóng dī mén jìnqù , zài qiángjiǎo zhǎodào yìméi lánsè sānjiǎo , bǎ xíngzhuàng chāo zài lǐng lái de zhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: They entered through a low door, found a blue triangle in the corner and copied its shape onto their issued sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 他们从低门进去，在墙角找到一枚蓝色三角，把形状抄在领来的纸上。

pairs.target: zhuǎn chūlái shí , qiánmiàn hūrán xiǎngqǐ le cí pèng cí de cuì shēng .
pairs.english: As they turned out, a sharp ceramic clink suddenly came from ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 转出来时，前面忽然响起了瓷碰瓷的脆声。

pairs.target: lìngyìzǔ yǒurén shuō shì xiá lǐ běnlái jiù sōng , fùzé jìshù de lǎoshī yǐjīng zài zhǐ shàng diǎn le yìbǐ .
pairs.english: Someone in another team said the contents had been loose already; the teacher keeping count had already made a mark on the paper.
pairs.hanzi: 另一组有人说是匣里本来就松，负责记数的老师已经在纸上点了一笔。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rěnbúzhù jiākuài bànbù , mǐlā shǒulǐ de xiá duān lìkè yì chén .
pairs.english: Tavi couldn't help quickening half a step; Mira's end of the box immediately dipped.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忍不住加快半步，米拉手里的匣端立刻一沉。

pairs.target: " màndiǎn . nǐ tuī zhe wǒ zǒu le . "
pairs.english: “Slow down. You're pushing me along.”
pairs.hanzi: “慢点。你推着我走了。”

pairs.target: tā shōuzhù jiǎo , xiá lǐ zhǐyǒu qīngqīng yì cā , méiyǒu xiǎng .
pairs.english: He checked his stride. Inside the box there was only a faint scrape, no clink.
pairs.hanzi: 他收住脚，匣里只有轻轻一擦，没有响。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ tú fàng dī yìdiǎn , cháo tā zuò le gè hěn nánkàn de guǐliǎn .
pairs.english: Iven lowered the map a little and made a hideous face at him.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把图放低一点，朝他做了个很难看的鬼脸。

pairs.target: tā chàdiǎn xiào , gāng zhāngzuǐ , mǐlā biàn shuō : " bié zài wǒ bèihòu xiào . shuō chūlái . "
pairs.english: He almost laughed, but the moment he opened his mouth Mira said, “Don't laugh behind my back. Say it out loud.”
pairs.hanzi: 他差点笑，刚张嘴，米拉便说：“别在我背后笑。说出来。”

pairs.target: yúshì yīwén yòu rào dào tā qiánmiàn zuò le yícì .
pairs.english: So Iven went around in front of her and did it again.
pairs.hanzi: 于是伊文又绕到她前面做了一次。

pairs.target: zhèhuí xiázǐ xiǎnxiē yīnwèi mǐlā de jiānbǎng zài dǒu ér xiǎng qǐlái .
pairs.english: This time the box nearly clinked because Mira's shoulders were shaking.
pairs.hanzi: 这回匣子险些因为米拉的肩膀在抖而响起来。

pairs.target: dìèrchù jìhào zài dōngcè shuǐcáo páng .
pairs.english: The second marker was beside the trough on the east side.
pairs.hanzi: 第二处记号在东侧水槽旁。

pairs.target: yuèguò xiǎoyuàn shí , tāmen kànjiàn yuánběn tōngxiàng dōngmén de duǎn láng héng zhe yídào hóng shéng .
pairs.english: Crossing the little courtyard, they saw a red rope stretched across the short corridor that had led to the east gate.
pairs.hanzi: 越过小院时，他们看见原本通向东门的短廊横着一道红绳。

pairs.target: shéng qián dīng le yíkuài xīn pái , xiě zhe " mónǐ luòshí ". tāmen huà de móxíng shàng méiyǒu zhège .
pairs.english: A new board fixed in front of it read “Simulated rockfall.” Their model hadn't included this.
pairs.hanzi: 绳前钉了一块新牌，写着“模拟落石”。他们画的模型上没有这个。

pairs.target: luò héng hé dé mǎ zhèngzài lìngyìtóu zhuǎnwān , yǐjīng rào xiàng běibiān .
pairs.english: Lohen and Dema were turning at the far end, already circling north.
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡和德玛正在另一头转弯，已经绕向北边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rènde nàtiáo lù , cháng , érqiě zuìhòu yào xià liǎngjí táijiē .
pairs.english: Tavi knew that route: long, with two steps down at the end.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认得那条路，长，而且最后要下两级台阶。

pairs.target: yǎnqián de hóng shéng dǐxià què kōng dé hěn , dī yíxiàtóu jiù guòqù le .
pairs.english: Yet beneath the red rope before them there was plenty of room; they could pass simply by ducking their heads.
pairs.hanzi: 眼前的红绳底下却空得很，低一下头就过去了。

pairs.target: yīwén dūnxià kàn tú . mǐlā fàngxià mùxiá , róu le yíxià zhǎng gēn .
pairs.english: Iven crouched to study the map. Mira set down the box and rubbed the heel of her palm.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文蹲下看图。米拉放下木匣，揉了一下掌根。

pairs.target: " móxíng cuò le ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “Was the model wrong?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “模型错了？”塔维问。

pairs.target: " móxíng shì qiántiān de . jīntiān duō le yíkuài shítou . "
pairs.english: “The model's from the day before yesterday. Today there's an extra rock.”
pairs.hanzi: “模型是前天的。今天多了一块石头。”

pairs.target: tā cháo páizi yáng le yáng xiàbā , " háishì yíkuài kànbújiàn de shítou . "
pairs.english: She lifted her chin at the board. “An invisible rock, at that.”
pairs.hanzi: 她朝牌子扬了扬下巴，“还是一块看不见的石头。”

pairs.target: hóng shéng páng de lǎoshī tīngjiàn , zuǐjiǎo dòng le yíxià , méiyǒu tì tāmen zhǐlù .
pairs.english: The teacher by the red rope heard her; the corner of their mouth twitched, but they didn't point out a route.
pairs.hanzi: 红绳旁的老师听见，嘴角动了一下，没有替他们指路。

pairs.target: yīwén zài tú shàng yánzhe hòu qiáng zhǎo le yíbiàn , zhǐxiàng shuǐcáo xīcè yìtiáo zhǎidào .
pairs.english: Iven searched along the back wall on the map and pointed to a narrow passage west of the trough.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在图上沿着后墙找了一遍，指向水槽西侧一条窄道。

pairs.target: tāmen kěyǐ cóng nàlǐ jìn , shǎo rào bàngè yuànzi .
pairs.english: They could enter there and save half a circuit of the courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 他们可以从那里进，少绕半个院子。

pairs.target: kětú shàng de tōngxíng kuāndù zhī biāo le rén , bìng méiyǒu suàn mùxiá .
pairs.english: But the clear width shown on the map allowed for a person, not the box.
pairs.hanzi: 可图上的通行宽度只标了人，并没有算木匣。

pairs.target: mǐlā ná chǐ bǐ guò xiá kuān , tǎ wéi guòqù kàn shíjì de mén .
pairs.english: Mira measured the box's width with a ruler, while Tavi went to check the actual door.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉拿尺比过匣宽，塔维过去看实际的门。

pairs.target: ménbiān jiù chāxiāo zhàn le jǐcùn , liǎnggè rén tái zhe zhuǎn bú jìnqù ;
pairs.english: An old bolt beside the door took up several inches; two people carrying it couldn't turn in.
pairs.hanzi: 门边旧插销占了几寸，两个人抬着转不进去；

pairs.target: gǎichéng yìqiányīhòu , xiá jiǎo yòu huì zhuàngqiáng .
pairs.english: If they changed to front and back, the box's corner would hit the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 改成一前一后，匣角又会撞墙。

pairs.target: tā huílái shí , dé mǎ nà zǔ yǐjīng líkāi dìèrchù jìhào , lánsè xiùkǒu cóng yuàn ménwài yì shǎn biàn méi le .
pairs.english: By the time he returned, Dema's team had left the second marker; a blue cuff flashed outside the yard gate and vanished.
pairs.hanzi: 他回来时，德玛那组已经离开第二处记号，蓝色袖口从院门外一闪便没了。

pairs.target: " běibiān . " tǎ wéi shuō .
pairs.english: “North,” Tavi said.
pairs.hanzi: “北边。”塔维说。

pairs.target: zhècì méiyǒu rén zhēng .
pairs.english: This time nobody argued.
pairs.hanzi: 这次没有人争。

pairs.target: yīwén xiān zǒu guòqù kàn táijiē , dūn zài xià yījí , shēnshǒu zhǐ gěi tāmen luòjiǎo de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Iven went ahead to inspect the steps, crouched on the lower one and pointed out where they should put their feet.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文先走过去看台阶，蹲在下一级，伸手指给他们落脚的地方。

pairs.target: mǐlā jiào tǎ wéi shù dào sān zài xià , jiéguǒ tā shù le yī , èr , tā jiù dòng le .
pairs.english: Mira told Tavi to count to three before stepping down, but he had counted one, two when she moved.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉叫塔维数到三再下，结果他数了一、二，她就动了。

pairs.target: cí huán qīngqīngchǔchǔ dì xiǎng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: The ceramic rings gave one unmistakable clink.
pairs.hanzi: 瓷环清清楚楚地响了一声。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhànzhù , bì le bìyǎn , suíhòu mà le yíjù hěn qīng dehuà .
pairs.english: Mira stopped, closed her eyes briefly, then swore very softly.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉站住，闭了闭眼，随后骂了一句很轻的话。

pairs.target: fùzé de lǎoshī jì le yìbǐ .
pairs.english: The supervising teacher made a mark.
pairs.hanzi: 负责的老师记了一笔。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi shuō " shì nǐ xiān dòng de ", yě méi zhuāngzuò méi tīngjiàn ;
pairs.english: Tavi didn't say, “You moved first,” nor did he pretend he hadn't heard.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没说“是你先动的”，也没装作没听见；

pairs.target: tā děng tā bǎshǒu huàn hǎo , wèn xià yìhuí shù dào sān , shì luòjiǎo háishì zhǔnbèi .
pairs.english: He waited while she adjusted her hands, then asked whether next time three meant stepping or getting ready.
pairs.hanzi: 他等她把手换好，问下一回数到三，是落脚还是准备。

pairs.target: " luòjiǎo . " tā shuō , " wǒ jìzhù le . "
pairs.english: “Stepping,” she said. “I'll remember.”
pairs.hanzi: “落脚。”她说，“我记住了。”

pairs.target: tāmen guò le dìèrchù jìhào , dào zhōngdiǎn shí , dé mǎ zhèng hē dìèrbēi shuǐ .
pairs.english: They passed the second marker; when they reached the finish, Dema was drinking her second cup of water.
pairs.hanzi: 他们过了第二处记号，到终点时，德玛正喝第二杯水。

pairs.target: chéngjì tiēchūlái , tā hé luò héng zuìkuài , cí huán yícì yě méi xiǎng .
pairs.english: When the results went up, she and Lohen were fastest, with not a single clink.
pairs.hanzi: 成绩贴出来，她和洛衡最快，瓷环一次也没响。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè zǔ pái zài zhōngjiān , hái kòu le yícì pèng xiǎng de fēn .
pairs.english: Tavi's team ranked in the middle, with points deducted for their one clink.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这组排在中间，还扣了一次碰响的分。

pairs.target: luò héng kànguò tāmen de tú , shuō zhǎidào tā yě xiǎng guò ,
pairs.english: Lohen looked at their map and said he'd considered the narrow passage too,
pairs.hanzi: 洛衡看过他们的图，说窄道他也想过，

pairs.target: dàn lǐng xiá shí biàn liáng guò kuāndù , suǒyǐ méiyǒu zài qù kānmén .
pairs.english: but had measured the width when collecting the box, so hadn't gone to check the door.
pairs.hanzi: 但领匣时便量过宽度，所以没有再去看门。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ zhège jì zài móxíng de kòngbáichù , zì xiě dé hěn zhòng .
pairs.english: Mira wrote this in a blank area of the model, pressing hard.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把这个记在模型的空白处，字写得很重。

pairs.target: dé mǎ còu guòlái , wèn nà jié néng chāi de wéilán mài bu mài , tā xiǎng gěi zìjǐ de lùxiàn bǎn yě zuò yígè .
pairs.english: Dema leaned over and asked whether the removable fence was for sale; she wanted one for her own route board.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛凑过来，问那截能拆的围栏卖不卖，她想给自己的路线板也做一个。

pairs.target: " bú mài . nǐ ná yàn huàn . " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: “Not for sale. Trade me a goose,” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi: “不卖。你拿雁换。”米拉说。

pairs.target: " zhè shì yàn ? " yīwén zhǐzhe dé mǎ lǐngkǒu biān gāng huà de xiǎoniǎo .
pairs.english: “That's a goose?” Iven pointed at the little bird freshly drawn near Dema's collar.
pairs.hanzi: “这是雁？”伊文指着德玛领口边刚画的小鸟。

pairs.target: dé mǎ mànmàn zhuǎnguò tóu . luò héng duān zhe shuǐ tuì kāi , dòngzuò bǐ gāngcái guòmén hái kuài .
pairs.english: Dema slowly turned her head. Lohen backed away holding his water, moving even faster than he had through the door.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛慢慢转过头。洛衡端着水退开，动作比刚才过门还快。
